title: rosa coriifolia f. minutiflora
intro: Rosa coriifolia f. minutiflora, commonly known as the small-flowered apple rose or Rosa coriifolia var. minutiflora, is a variant of the Rosa coriifolia plant, a species of rose native to the Himalayas. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever, inflammation, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Rosa coriifolia f. minutiflora are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral activities. The plant's bioactive constituents may also contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various health conditions, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
